description: Whatever is at the end of the tunnel is meant for me #selflove #dreamlife #selfpresservation
transcript: sadness, anxiety, regret, can not only reshape who you are, but redirect your path towards destruction. That is why I am serious about my life, doing all of that at the 30,000 foot level. While I still know what's going on in this present moment, I'm okay with whatever the outcome is. I do not pressure my life one direction over the other. How it goes is how it goes and whatever the outcome is meant to be is what it's meant to be, but I'm going to enjoy it along the process.
